About the job

🚀 ¡Únete a DC Gaskets! Estamos buscando talento en Marketing Digital

En DC Gaskets, empresa mexicana especializada en la fabricación y comercialización de juntas, empaques y componentes para motor, estamos buscando incorporar a nuestro equipo a un(a):




ESPECIALISTA EN MARKETING DIGITAL

Buscamos una persona creativa, analítica, proactiva y orientada a resultados, que nos ayude a fortalecer nuestra presencia digital, desarrollar nuestras marcas y generar una conexión más sólida con clientes, distribuidores, mecánicos y nuevos prospectos.




¿Cuál será tu reto?

Formarás parte del área de Comercialización, participando en la creación y ejecución de estrategias digitales enfocadas en posicionamiento de marca, generación de demanda, análisis de mercado y crecimiento comercial.

Entre tus principales responsabilidades estarán:

Diseñar e implementar estrategias de Marketing Digital.
Administrar y desarrollar contenido para nuestras Redes Sociales.
Crear contenidos gráficos y audiovisuales: fotografía, video, animaciones y textos.
Desarrollar campañas digitales para la captación de prospectos y posicionamiento de marca.
Ejecutar y dar seguimiento a estrategias de SEO y SEM.
Monitorear resultados, métricas, tendencias y comportamiento de nuestras audiencias.
Realizar estudios de mercado y análisis de competencia.
Optimizar campañas y presupuestos con base en información y resultados.
Supervisar y mantener actualizado el contenido de nuestras páginas web.
Preparar reportes de desempeño y proponer nuevas estrategias de crecimiento.
Participar en proyectos, exposiciones, eventos y actividades comerciales de la empresa.


¿Qué estamos buscando?

🎓 Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Diseño, Comunicación o carrera afín.

💼 Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en Marketing Digital o posiciones similares.

🌎 Inglés avanzado (aprox. 90%).

📊 Conocimientos y experiencia en:

Redes Sociales y plataformas de publicidad digital.
SEO y SEM.
Analítica y medición de resultados.
Gestión de proyectos.
MS Office.
Adobe Creative Cloud: Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere, InDesign, Lightroom y herramientas relacionadas.
Fotografía y producción de video.
Desarrollo y gestión de contenido digital.


Valoramos especialmente a personas que tengan:

✅ Excelente comunicación verbal y escrita.

✅ Muy buena redacción y ortografía.

✅ Pensamiento analítico y capacidad para interpretar datos.

✅ Creatividad e iniciativa para proponer nuevas ideas.

✅ Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y con diferentes áreas de la organización.

✅ Orientación a resultados y cumplimiento de objetivos.

✅ Disponibilidad para viajar.




¿Por qué DC Gaskets?

Porque buscamos llevar nuestras marcas a un siguiente nivel.

Queremos sumar a una persona que no solamente publique contenido, sino que sea capaz de entender el mercado, analizar información, identificar oportunidades y convertir una estrategia digital en resultados para el negocio.

Si te apasiona el Marketing Digital, la creación de contenido, el análisis de datos y quieres desarrollarte dentro de una empresa mexicana con presencia en el mercado automotriz nacional e internacional, queremos conocerte.

📩 Postúlate o envíanos tu CV y portafolio.




También agradeceremos compartir esta publicación con alguien que pudiera encajar con el perfil.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As a User Operations Intern, you will support the Growth Ops team in driving user growth and engagement. You’ll gain hands-on experience in analyzing user data, designing promotional strategies, and coordinating cross-functional projects that improve the user journey. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to learn how tech companies scale products and optimize operations.

In this role, you'll be...


Support merchant growth campaigns across convenience, grocery, and pharmacy categories.
Analyze performance metrics (orders, coupons, GMV, retention rates) and prepare weekly reports.
Assist with the design, testing, and tracking of user incentives and promotional strategies.
Coordinate with marketing, commercial, and product teams to ensure smooth execution of campaigns.
Help monitor user feedback, identify pain points, and suggest improvements to the user experience.
Conduct market research and benchmarking against competitors.
Support day-to-day operations, including updating internal trackers and documenting processes.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Currently pursuing a degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field. 
Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets. 
Interest in tech, e-commerce, or delivery platforms. 
Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn. 
Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

About the job

Modalidad: Híbrida (Presencial durante los primeros 2 meses).

Localización: Ciudad de México

Nivel de empleo: Senior

Desde Candee estamos gestionando esta posición de Paid Media Lead para DOVER.

¿Qué es DOVER?

DOVER es una agencia de medios de origen latinoamericano y alcance global que busca ir más allá de los medios tradicionales. Diseña estrategias que conectan el mundo físico y digital, combinando data, tecnología, creatividad y conocimiento de las personas para generar conexiones relevantes entre marcas y audiencias.

Trabajan con una visión integral de las campañas, desde la estrategia y planificación hasta su ejecución, monitoreo y análisis de resultados, con servicios de SEM, Social Ads, programática, CRM, influencers y estrategias Full Funnel.

¿Qué hace que Dover sea un lugar único?

Según nos ha contado el equipo de DOVER, lo mejor de trabajar aquí es:


🌱 Deja huella mientras el equipo crece: ayudarás a elevar el nivel del área y a impulsar el desarrollo de las personas.
🤝 Un equipo donde importan las personas y las perspectivas: diversidad, inclusión y experiencias diferentes forman parte de su manera de trabajar.
🎓 Mucho espacio para aprender y enseñar: compartir conocimiento y hacer crecer al equipo será tan importante como lograr resultados.


¿Cómo será tu equipo?

Formarás parte del equipo de Paid Media de DOVER, trabajando junto a otros especialistas encargados de operar las campañas digitales de los clientes.

Reportarás al Paid Media Manager y actuarás como su mano derecha, siendo el/la principal referente técnico del equipo. No tendrás personas a tu cargo de manera formal, pero sí un papel importante acompañando a perfiles más junior, resolviendo dudas, revisando su trabajo y ayudando a elevar el nivel técnico de la operación.

En el día a día trabajarás también de forma coordinada con otros perfiles y áreas de la agencia y, en las cuentas que lideres técnicamente, podrás participar en conversaciones con clientes para aportar la visión estratégica y especializada de Paid Media.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Tu misión será convertirte en una referencia técnica dentro del equipo de Paid Media, asegurando que las campañas se creen, configuren y optimicen con precisión, consistencia y altos estándares de calidad.

Tendrás un rol muy hands-on en plataforma, pero tu impacto irá más allá de ejecutar campañas: también tendrás ownership técnico sobre algunas cuentas, participarás en el diseño de sus estrategias de Paid Media y ayudarás a detectar oportunidades, mejorar procesos, documentar buenas prácticas y acompañar técnicamente al resto del equipo.

Tus principales funciones serán:


Liderar técnicamente cuentas clave, asegurando que la estrategia y la ejecución de Paid Media respondan a los objetivos definidos para cada cliente.
Diseñar estrategias de Paid Media para las cuentas asignadas, definiendo el enfoque de canales y las líneas de acción más adecuadas en función de sus objetivos.
Crear, configurar y optimizar campañas de Paid Media en Google Ads —Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display y YouTube—, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads y Microsoft Ads, además de Programmatic / DV360.
Ejecutar optimizaciones continuas en función de los objetivos de performance definidos por el Paid Media Manager, priorizando las acciones según su impacto en resultados, inversión, eficiencia y oportunidad de negocio.
Analizar el rendimiento de las campañas a través de KPIs clave: inversión, CPC, CPM, CTR, CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversiones, revenue, frecuencia y tasa de conversión.
Detectar problemas y oportunidades de mejora relacionados con performance, tracking, configuración o estructura de campañas, convirtiendo el análisis en acciones concretas de optimización.
Identificar patrones, aprendizajes y oportunidades entre diferentes cuentas, documentando los cambios relevantes, hipótesis de optimización y aprendizajes obtenidos.
Actuar como referente técnico para traffickers y perfiles más junior, revisando configuraciones, optimizaciones, análisis y propuestas y dando feedback práctico y orientado a la mejora.
Acompañar el desarrollo técnico del equipo, resolviendo dudas operativas y compartiendo buenas prácticas, novedades de plataformas y aprendizajes relevantes, sin asumir la gestión formal de personas.
Apoyar al Paid Media Manager aportando una lectura técnica sobre el performance y la evolución de las campañas.


¿Qué están buscando? 

Buscamos una persona con una base muy sólida y hands-on en Paid Media, capaz de moverse con autonomía en plataforma, analizar resultados con criterio y convertirse en un referente técnico para otros miembros del equipo.

Alguien con:


Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en agencias de medios, digitales o integrales.
Experiencia sólida en Paid Media y gestión operativa de campañas digitales.
Dominio avanzado de Google Ads y Meta Ads; así como en TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Pinterest Ads, Microsoft Ads y compra programática.
Conocimiento de Media Planning, KPIs, Funnels y Customer Journey.
Experiencia creando, mejorando o estructurando procesos operativos.
Experiencia acompañando técnicamente a perfiles junior, aunque no es necesario haber tenido responsabilidad formal de gestión de personas.
Perfil técnico, analítico y con mucha atención al detalle.

Buena capacidad de comunicación interna y facilidad para explicar cuestiones técnicas de forma clara.

title: Ingeniero de telefonía móvil
description:
About the job

En Kigo convertimos filas en flujo. Somos la llave de las ciudades inteligentes: identidad, accesos y pagos en una sola plataforma, conectada al mundo físico (barreras, torniquetes, cámaras, parquímetros) en 75+ ciudades, con 5.7M usuarios y 76M de operaciones al año.




Nuestra app es una pieza central de esa experiencia: pagos, accesos, QR, mapas, reservas, notificaciones y comunicación con infraestructura física en tiempo real. Buscamos un Senior Mobile Developer que nos ayude a llevarla al siguiente nivel: alguien fuerte técnicamente, obsesionado con la experiencia del usuario y capaz de hacerse dueño de una funcionalidad desde la arquitectura hasta producción.




Qué vas a hacer

Construir y evolucionar nuestra app en Flutter, trabajando en funcionalidades que conectan software con el mundo físico: QR, cámara, mapas, geolocalización, pagos, deep links, push notifications, Bluetooth y experiencias offline.




Esperamos hands-on real: diseñar soluciones, escribir código, revisar PRs, detectar problemas de performance, resolver crashes y tomar decisiones que mantengan una app utilizada a escala estable y rápida.




También vas a trabajar de cerca con Backend, Product, Design, QA e IoT para construir experiencias completas, no solamente pantallas.




Lo que buscamos

Experiencia sólida construyendo aplicaciones móviles que ya viven en producción, idealmente con una base importante de usuarios.




Dominio de Flutter y Dart, arquitectura mobile, state management, consumo de APIs, concurrencia, almacenamiento local y lifecycle de aplicaciones.




Experiencia resolviendo problemas reales de performance, estabilidad y compatibilidad entre dispositivos.

Buscamos alguien con criterio técnico, que pueda investigar un problema sin esperar instrucciones paso a paso, que sepa cuándo abstraer y cuándo mantener las cosas simples, y que entienda que una feature no termina cuando funciona en su teléfono: termina cuando funciona bien en producción.




Experiencia trabajando con código nativo en Swift/iOS y Kotlin/Android suma muchos puntos. Tenemos funcionalidades donde toca bajar a nativo, integrar SDKs, trabajar con permisos, capabilities del dispositivo y resolver problemas específicos de cada plataforma.




Nuestro stack mobile




Flutter, Dart, Swift, Kotlin, Firebase, PostHog.




Integraciones con cámara, QR, mapas, geolocalización, push notifications, deep links, Bluetooth/BLE, biometría y capacidades nativas de iOS y Android.




Desarrollo spec-driven, testing automatizado, observabilidad de producción y product analytics. AI tooling auditado y gobernado.




AI no es opcional




Trabajamos con AI integrada en todo el ciclo: harness de desarrollo (Claude Code, Kiro), generación spec-driven, debugging, testing, code reviews y agentes en flujos reales.




Buscamos a alguien que ya use AI como parte natural de su forma de desarrollar, que sepa darle contexto, validar lo que genera y utilizarla para moverse más rápido sin sacrificar calidad.




También esperamos criterio sobre sus límites: seguridad, código sensible, datos de usuarios y saber qué se puede delegar y qué requiere revisión humana.

description:
About the job

about lumina. 

Lumina is a technology-enabled hospitality company operating a curated portfolio of boutique hotels, luxury villas, and design-led residences across Mexico, the United States, and the Dominican Republic. We build the systems that make great hospitality repeatable: proprietary technology, data-driven distribution and revenue management, operational discipline, and 24/7 guest support. Our operating portfolio and signed pipeline span 35+ properties and 1,000+ rooms across 12+ cities. Every one of those was a decision about where to deploy capital, which market to enter, and how to fund it. That is the work you would be joining. luminastays.com · lumina-hospitality.com 




the role. 

You will sit next to the CFO on the decisions that set Lumina's trajectory: which markets we enter, which properties we take on, how we structure the deals, and where the capital comes from. This is not a support seat. You will build the models that go to our board, run diligence on live transactions, and present to owners and investors who write real checks. It is the right fit if you have transaction or strategic-finance experience, you are comfortable in a room with senior stakeholders, and you would rather own a decision than model someone else's. 




what you will do. 

Strategic planning. Lead long-term planning and build financial projections for Lumina, its business units, and individual projects. Find the levers that improve performance and return on invested capital, then make the case for pulling them.
Transactions. Run deal execution end to end: due diligence, financial modeling, coordination with legal counsel and external advisors on documentation, and postclosing integration.
Budgeting and performance. Own budgets, forecasts, and variance analysis across the portfolio, tracking property-level P&L, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, margins, and cash flow. 
Stakeholder reporting: Prepare and coordinate monthly reporting to asset owners, investors, and the executive team.
Market intelligence. Research target markets and competitors, and build the fundraising materials that follow: models, memoranda, and roadshow presentations. 
Cross-functional work. Work directly with Operations, Revenue Management, and Accounting to turn what happens inside our properties into financial insight the business can act on. 




what you bring.

Three to five years in investment banking, transaction advisory, private equity, corporate development, strategic finance, FP&A, equity research, or management consulting. 
Deep command of accounting and corporate finance, including financial modeling and company valuation. 
A track record of building board-level presentations and investment memoranda that hold up under scrutiny.
Strategic instincts, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to learn fast and drive cross-functional work in a company that moves quickly. 
Sharp quantitative and problem-solving skills, real attention to detail, and the presence to build trust with senior stakeholders. 
Fluency in English and Spanish. 
Nice to have: experience in hospitality, real estate, or multi-unit businesses, and fluency with AI tools. 




what we offer. 

Competitive salary and benefits. 
Direct access to the CFO, the executive team, and our investors. Your work lands in front of decision-makers, not in a deck someone else presents. 
Exposure across three countries and multiple asset classes, from boutique hotels to condo-hotel rental pools.
Room to grow with the company. 




The portfolio and geographic footprint are expanding, and so is the scope of this role.

About the job

Descripción de la empresa Haulsa Logistics es una empresa de logística fundada en Monterrey, Nuevo León, en 2015, especializada en soluciones de transporte terrestre nacional e internacional. Ofrecemos un servicio personalizado apoyado en tecnología, lo que nos permite mantener una comunicación continua 24/7 con nuestra clientela. Nuestro equipo está formado por personas altamente capacitadas, con experiencia en el sector y gran capacidad de adaptación a las necesidades de cada proyecto. Nos enfocamos en la eficiencia, la seguridad y la fiabilidad en cada envío, creando relaciones de largo plazo con quienes confían en nuestros servicios.

En tu día a día analizarás costes operativos, márgenes y condiciones comerciales, prepararás cotizaciones para clientes y colaborarás con los equipos de ventas y operaciones para diseñar propuestas a medida. También realizarás seguimiento de indicadores de precios, mercado y competencia, identificando oportunidades de mejora en nuestra estrategia de pricing. LCL).

Excel, TMS).

* Capacidad analítica, atención al detalle y aptitudes para trabajar con grandes volúmenes de información numérica.

description:

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Role will be based in Mexico City, Mexico

We are looking for a Solution Engineer who is accustomed to solving customer’s most complex problems and closing large deals. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, provide compelling value-based demonstrations, support enterprise Proof of Concepts, and ultimately help customers grow in their use of Snowflake.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion about reinventing the AI Data platform space, thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop with technical audiences.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:


Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at Snowflake customers and prospects
Work hands-on with customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology; identify use cases, and guide the customer to successfully take them from demo to implementation, and a successful go-live.
Present Customers with the innovations in Snowflake and the value these innovations add to their business.
Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.
Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing.



ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:


Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
Broad range of experience within large-scale Database and/or Data Warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud technologies
Hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics
Ability to understand a customer’s specific business problems and translate these to Snowflake use cases
University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred
Travel Required



 ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solution Engineers are customer obsessed and we believe in the value we can add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the job

Join the team turning ad creative into pipeline revenue for local businesses.




Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, hola, hallo, vítejte!




Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.




We're Goat Media. We film creative ads, script them strategically, run paid campaigns, and drive qualified leads into our clients' pipelines. If it doesn't drive revenue, it doesn't get done. That's not a tagline, that's the operating system.




We need a creative strategist to be the engine behind our ad creative and client fulfillment. That's where you come in.




Responsibilities 

Content Strategy & Scripting

Develop the content strategy for each client based on their business, their audience, their pain points, and their goals. Write scripts for face-to-camera videos, short-form content, and any other format we deploy. Every script has a purpose, a hook, a message, and a reason it exists on the platform it's going to.

Platform Distribution Thinking

You understand that YouTube is not Instagram is not TikTok. You know what works on each platform, what format each one rewards, what posting cadence makes sense, and why posting the same video everywhere without adaptation is lazy and ineffective. You think about distribution before you write a single word.

Creative Angle Development

Generate new messaging angles based on client business data, customer insights, competitor research, and platform trends. Build and maintain swipe files using tools like Meta Ad Library, Google Ad Library, and competitor research tools. You're always hunting for the next angle that could crack open a client's growth.

Creative Briefs

Own the briefing process end-to-end. Write clear, specific briefs for videographers, editors, and any other production resources. A brief that leaves room for interpretation is a brief that produces the wrong content. You eliminate ambiguity.

Performance Analysis

Work closely with our media buyers to understand what's performing and what's not. Look at ad performance data, engagement metrics, and platform analytics to inform your next round of creative. You don't guess, you read the data and adjust. You understand creative testing methodologies and you know that only a small percentage of creatives will actually scale.

Client Content Calendars

Build and maintain content calendars for each client. Plan content weeks ahead, not day-of. Ensure every piece of content has a strategic reason for existing and maps to a business outcome the client cares about.

Market & Competitor Research

Stay current on platform algorithm changes, content trends, and what competitors in each client's space are doing. Use that intelligence to keep our clients ahead, not reacting.




The type of creative

We don't want boring contractor ads that sound like every other company. We want ads that make people stop scrolling and actually want to watch.

Think interesting hooks, storytelling, UGC-style videos, before and afters, customer mistakes, educational content, "things nobody tells you" angles, cost breakdowns, contractor tips, humor, curiosity-driven ideas, and problem/solution content.

You should know what makes content go viral and why people stop scrolling. You understand the psychology behind why someone watches a video to the end versus swiping past it in two seconds. You study consumer behavior, buyer behavior, and human psychology because you know that great advertising is applied psychology, not guesswork.




Qualifications

English C1 or higher. All scripts, briefs, and client-facing communication will be in English. You need to write at a level that reads naturally, not like a translated second language.




5+ years experience in this role or a similar creative strategy, copywriting, or advertising role. You've been in the trenches. You know what a good ad looks like because you've written hundreds of them and watched the data come back.




Deep understanding of copywriting, advertising, and consumer psychology. You know why people click, watch, engage, and buy. You understand buyer behavior and human psychology because you've studied it, not because you read one book on it. You know what makes content go viral and you can explain the mechanism behind it, not just point to a trend.




Strong social media understanding. You know why certain content formats perform on certain platforms, how algorithms reward different behaviors, and how to adapt a single piece of content across multiple platforms without just copy-pasting.




Knows the big advertisers and the greats. You follow the people who are actually moving the needle in advertising. You study their work, you understand why it works, and you're not stuck in 2015 direct response thinking.




Hungry and wants to learn about advertising. You're not here to clock in, do your hours, and disappear. You're genuinely obsessed with getting better at this craft. You're the type who watches ad breakdowns for fun and gets excited about a new angle that cracks open a campaign.




Winner mindset. You take feedback well and you're always looking to improve. You're not precious about your creative. You don't write generic or corporate-sounding copy. You're comfortable coming up with ideas without being told exactly what to do. You're a creative thinker who's passionate about marketing.




Team player. You work well alongside media buyers, editors, and videographers. You communicate clearly, you take ownership, and you don't throw your work over a wall and hope for the best.




Creative testing mindset. You understand that most creatives won't scale, and you're comfortable with that. You know how to test systematically, read results, and iterate without emotional attachment to your work.




Can research and understand new industries quickly. Every client is in a different space. You need to be able to drop into a new industry, understand the customer, the pain points, the language, and the competitive landscape fast, then write ads that sound like you've been in that industry for years.




About The Company

We're Goat Media, a paid advertising company built on one principle: revenue-driven actions. If something isn't bringing revenue, there's zero point in doing it.

We film creative ads for local businesses (nationwide), script them strategically, and run paid campaigns that drive qualified leads into our clients' pipelines. We're not a social media management agency that posts content and hopes for engagement. We're a performance company that ties every ad, every script, and every dollar of spend to revenue coming back through the door.




Other Details

Location: Remote 

Type: Full-time 

Compensation: $2,500 to $3,000/month

Schedule: Monday to Friday, aligned to US time zones

About the job

Business Development & Sales Executive — Mexico

Department: Business Development / Sales

 Location: Mexico

 Work model: Remote

 Employment type: Full-time — Individual Contributor

 Reports directly to: Head of Marketing — Mexico




 Travel: Occasional travel to the United States may be required

About the Role

Trademarkia Mexico is looking for a results-driven Business Development & Sales Executive with a strong focus on customer acquisition and revenue generation.

This person will own the full commercial cycle, from the initial contact with Marketing-generated leads through qualification, follow-up, sales meetings, closing and payment.

In addition to managing inbound opportunities, the role will be responsible for generating new business through outbound prospecting, lead reactivation, referrals, partnerships and new acquisition channels.

We are looking for someone with a hunter + closer mindset who can build trust, understand customer needs, handle objections and consistently move opportunities toward a commercial decision.

The position will work directly with the Head of Marketing — Mexico and will have direct responsibility for contributing to Trademarkia Mexico's revenue growth.

Primary Objective

Turn commercial opportunities into customers and revenue through:

Disciplined lead management.
Consistent follow-up.
Consultative sales meetings.
Sales closing.
Outbound prospecting.
Lead reactivation.
Development of new acquisition channels.
Accurate pipeline management.

Success in this position will ultimately be measured by the ability to generate consistent and predictable revenue.

Key Responsibilities1. Lead Management

Own and manage leads generated through Trademarkia Mexico's Marketing initiatives.

Responsibilities include:

Contacting leads coming from digital campaigns, the website, social media, referrals and additional acquisition channels.
Following the response-time standards and follow-up cadences established in the Mexico Lead Management SOP.
Using WhatsApp Business, phone calls, email and video calls to communicate with prospects.
Personalizing communication according to each prospect's needs and context.
Properly qualifying each opportunity.
Understanding customer needs, urgency, purchase intent and ability to move forward.
Maintaining consistent follow-up until a commercial outcome is reached.
Recovering leads that stop responding.
Executing the established no-show recovery process.
Ensuring every active opportunity has a defined next step.
Accurately documenting calls, messages, meetings, objections and next actions in the CRM.

The expectation is simple: no commercially viable lead should be left without follow-up.

2. Sales Meetings

The executive will conduct approximately 30-minute consultative sales meetings with prospective customers.

During these conversations, the executive should:

Understand the prospect's situation and needs.
Identify key questions and objections.
Clearly explain Trademarkia, its services and the customer journey.
Communicate benefits and next steps in a simple and transparent way.
Build trust throughout the decision-making process.
Handle commercial objections related to pricing, timing, process and trust.
Identify buying signals.
Move the conversation toward a clear next action.
Ask for the sale when appropriate.
Provide payment instructions or links when the customer is ready.
Follow up immediately after the meeting.

Questions requiring specialized legal advice must be escalated to the appropriate legal team.

The executive must not guarantee legal outcomes or provide unauthorized legal advice.

3. Follow-Up & Closing

The position will be responsible for moving each qualified opportunity toward a final commercial decision.

Responsibilities include:

Following up after calls and meetings.
Addressing commercial questions.
Providing relevant information and materials.
Sharing payment links or payment instructions.
Identifying and removing barriers to purchase.
Handling objections.
Asking for the sale at the appropriate moment.
Reactivating stalled opportunities.
Maintaining a clearly defined next step for every opportunity.
Confirming payment before recognizing an opportunity as closed revenue.

The goal is not simply to have sales conversations. The goal is to convert opportunities into paying customers.

4. Outbound Prospecting & New Business Development

The role should not depend exclusively on Marketing-generated leads.

The executive will also:

Identify potential companies and prospects.
Build prospect lists.
Conduct outbound outreach.
Prospect through LinkedIn, email, calls, WhatsApp, networking and referrals.
Generate new sales conversations.
Develop strategic partnerships.
Identify associations, agencies, firms and communities that could generate opportunities.
Develop referral opportunities.
Identify new market segments.
Propose new customer acquisition channels.
Test commercial initiatives.
Measure the revenue generated through those initiatives.
5. Pipeline Management

The executive will own the accuracy and health of the sales pipeline.

Responsibilities include:

Keeping the CRM updated.
Correctly categorizing opportunities.
Recording estimated opportunity value.
Maintaining expected close dates.
Recording next actions.
Prioritizing high-intent opportunities.
Preventing opportunities from becoming stagnant.
Identifying pipeline risks.
Reporting progress and opportunities to the Head of Marketing — Mexico.
Analyzing lost opportunities.
Identifying reactivation opportunities.
6. Collaboration with Marketing

Because the position reports directly to the Head of Marketing — Mexico, Sales and Marketing will work closely together.

The executive will:

Provide feedback on lead quality.
Identify the campaigns producing the strongest opportunities.
Share common prospect questions and objections.
Identify the messages that produce better sales conversations.
Document loss reasons.
Identify promising customer segments.
Contribute insights for landing pages and commercial materials.
Identify reactivation opportunities.
Propose new acquisition initiatives.
Help improve the complete Marketing → Sales → Revenue funnel.
Performance Metrics

Although variable compensation will be based exclusively on revenue, operational performance will also be monitored through metrics such as:

Lead response time.
Contact rate.
Meetings booked.
Meeting show rate.
No-show recovery.
Lead-to-meeting conversion.
Meeting-to-sale conversion.
Close rate.
Pipeline generated.
Average sales cycle.
Outbound prospecting activity.
Self-generated opportunities.
Lead Management SOP compliance.
CRM accuracy.
Revenue generated.

These metrics help evaluate and optimize sales performance but do not directly determine the monthly performance bonus.

Compensation : competitive.

As a design firm, Gensler is committed to being client-first, diverse, exploratory, and sustainably minded.

You are a hands-on designer with a passion for inspiring design and visual storytelling, capable of capturing and communicating a client’s brand essence and story using 2D and 3D applications.

Life at Gensler

We encourage every person at Gensler to lead a healthy and balanced life. Our comprehensive benefits include subsidized health and life insurance, annual bonus, LinkedIn learning, holiday observance, and employee assistance programs.

We also reimburse tuition for certain eligible programs or classes. We view our professional development programs as strategic investments in our future.

Verificar la identidad del cliente y validar datos base de contacto de acuerdo con los procedimientos y controles operativos autorizados, antes de comunicar cualquier información de la oferta.

Confirmar la elegibilidad y condiciones de la oferta precalificada (producto, monto/línea, vigencia, condiciones clave) en los sistemas y herramientas autorizados, evitando promesas fuera de lo autorizado.

Comunicar de manera clara, precisa y transparente las características, beneficios, restricciones, requisitos, tasas, comisiones, CAT cuando aplique, costos, condiciones y vigencia de la oferta, asegurando la comprensión del cliente.
Aplicar venta consultiva enfocada en necesidades del cliente, incluyendo manejo de objeciones y técnicas de cierre, manteniendo un enfoque ético y centrado en el cliente.
Obtener y registrar el consentimiento del cliente para continuar con la gestión comercial y el tratamiento/uso de información, conforme a los lineamientos internos y regulatorios aplicables.

Gestionar dudas e inquietudes sobre el producto ofrecido, explicando alcances y pasos del proceso; canalizar correctamente solicitudes fuera de alcance (aclaraciones, quejas, temas operativos) al área correspondiente.
Ejecutar la colocación/solicitud siguiendo el guion (script) y el flujo definido para ofertas precalificadas, cuidando que la información capturada sea consistente y completa.

Registrar de forma correcta, completa y oportuna cada interacción en los sistemas autorizados: resultado de llamada, estatus de venta, motivos de rechazo/no contacto, acuerdos, seguimiento y evidencias requeridas.
Cumplir con objetivos individuales de ventas, conversión, productividad y calidad, tales como contactos efectivos, tasa de cierre, cumplimiento de script, calidad de captura y auditorías de llamada.

Asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas internas, controles operativos, estándares de conducta y normativa aplicable en México, incluyendo confidencialidad/privacidad de datos, prácticas de venta responsable y comunicación transparente.
Contribuir a un ambiente de control interno sólido, identificando y reportando oportunamente incidentes, desviaciones, posibles fraudes, malas prácticas, riesgos operativos o quejas del cliente.
Brindar una experiencia positiva durante todo el contacto: trato respetuoso, lenguaje claro, ritmo adecuado, empatía, y cierre cordial independientemente del resultado.

Verificar la identidad del cliente y validar datos base de contacto de acuerdo con los procedimientos y controles operativos autorizados, antes de comunicar cualquier información de la oferta.
Confirmar la elegibilidad y condiciones de la oferta precalificada (producto, monto/línea, vigencia, condiciones clave) en los sistemas y herramientas autorizados, evitando promesas fuera de lo autorizado.
Comunicar de manera clara, precisa y transparente las características, beneficios, restricciones, requisitos, tasas, comisiones, CAT cuando aplique, costos, condiciones y vigencia de la oferta, asegurando la comprensión del cliente.
Aplicar venta consultiva enfocada en necesidades del cliente, incluyendo manejo de objeciones y técnicas de cierre, manteniendo un enfoque ético y centrado en el cliente.
Obtener y registrar el consentimiento del cliente para continuar con la gestión comercial y el tratamiento/uso de información, conforme a los lineamientos internos y regulatorios aplicables.
Gestionar dudas e inquietudes sobre el producto ofrecido, explicando alcances y pasos del proceso; canalizar correctamente solicitudes fuera de alcance (aclaraciones, quejas, temas operativos) al área correspondiente.
Ejecutar la colocación/solicitud siguiendo el guion (script) y el flujo definido para ofertas precalificadas, cuidando que la información capturada sea consistente y completa.
Registrar de forma correcta, completa y oportuna cada interacción en los sistemas autorizados: resultado de llamada, estatus de venta, motivos de rechazo/no contacto, acuerdos, seguimiento y evidencias requeridas.
Cumplir con objetivos individuales de ventas, conversión, productividad y calidad, tales como contactos efectivos, tasa de cierre, cumplimiento de script, calidad de captura y auditorías de llamada.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas internas, controles operativos, estándares de conducta y normativa aplicable en México, incluyendo confidencialidad/privacidad de datos, prácticas de venta responsable y comunicación transparente.

Brindar una experiencia positiva durante todo el contacto: trato respetuoso, lenguaje claro, ritmo adecuado, empatía, y cierre cordial independientemente del resultado.

About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Manager, Area Marketing

Overview

About the job

1.) Introduction

Job Title: Organic Investor & Brand Growth Specialist
Work Hours/Schedule: Part-Time to start (around 20 hours per week) with a clear path to full-time. Flexible schedule, no fixed shift required, with a couple of hours of daily overlap with EST for calls and check-ins
Location: Fully Remote (open to Latin America, South Africa, and the Philippines)
Structure: Project-based ramp up. You start with a defined project and clear outcomes, then take on more scope as you prove results




2.) Overview

If you can turn a founder's raw thinking into content that makes serious investors reach out, this seat was built for you.




This is a small, founder-led U.S. based real estate investment firm operating on a private equity model. They raise capital from experienced professionals, senior executives, and business owners who partner with them on deals, typically wiring somewhere between fifty thousand and two hundred fifty thousand dollars per investment. The business is lean, transparent, and allergic to corporate theater. The founder says exactly what he means, expects the same in return, and measures work by whether it moves the number.




Right now the founder is doing most of this himself. He is writing the content, running the podcast, doing the outreach, and nurturing the pipeline. This role exists to take that entire engine off his plate and then make it better. You will own organic content across LinkedIn, YouTube, and podcasts, build the lead magnets and follow up sequences that warm prospective investors, and track what is actually converting so you can do more of it. The end goal is simple and easy to measure: more qualified investor calls booked.




3.) Key Responsibilities

Create and manage organic content across LinkedIn, YouTube, podcasts, and other social channels
Transform raw founder ideas into engaging written and video content designed to attract prospective investors
Refine content hooks, messaging, and structure to increase audience trust and inbound interest
Build and manage simple organic lead funnels, including lead magnets, automated messaging, and follow up sequences
Nurture prospective investors and move them from initial interest toward qualified booked calls
Track performance data to identify high converting content, optimize outreach efforts, and drive booked calls
Repurpose top performing content across multiple platforms to maximize reach and audience consistency
Own and continuously improve the brand growth process, proactively identifying new ways to generate qualified investor calls and contribute directly to revenue




4.) Must-Have Requirements

Proven experience managing organic content strategy and brand growth across major social platforms
Demonstrated ability to translate complex concepts into clear, engaging written and video content
Experience building organic lead funnels and nurture sequences that move prospects toward booked calls
Strong messaging skills with an understanding of content positioning and audience engagement
Ability to evaluate content performance data and proactively adapt strategy based on results
Strong ownership mindset, able to design their own workload around a stated outcome rather than waiting for instructions
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
Availability for part-time hours with a couple of hours of daily overlap with EST




5.) Nice-to-Have Requirements

Prior experience creating content tailored specifically to investor acquisition or finance audiences
Familiarity with video and podcast content editing workflows for multi-platform distribution
Track record of researching content trends and competitor strategies to unlock new growth opportunities
Comfort using AI tools to speed up repurposing and content production
Experience documenting processes and building SOPs others can follow




6.) Why Join Us

Most content roles bury you three layers below the person making decisions. This one puts you directly next to the founder, working on the single thing that grows the business. There is no committee, no brand deck to get approved, and no waiting two weeks for feedback. You bring an idea, you ship it, you see what it did.




The upside here is real. This is a lean team where every result is visible, which means the person who drives investor calls does not go unnoticed. The founder has been clear that he wants to grow this person, hand them more responsibility, and open up performance based upside for someone who genuinely moves the needle. You start with a defined project and a clear outcome, and the scope expands as fast as you can prove yourself. If you want a seat where your work is measured by results instead of hours logged, and where doing well actually changes your trajectory, this is it.

description:
About the job

Position: Marketing Lead

Location: Remote: LatAm

Schedule: Central Daylight Time - CDT hours

Salary: $2500

About US

We are dedicated to providing compassionate, top-tier legal representation in family law. As a rapidly growing firm based in Texas, we rely on innovation, data-driven decisions, and exceptional client experiences to drive our expansion. We are not looking for someone to simply manage tasks or report metrics—we are looking for a true business leader to take complete ownership of our entire marketing function, build scalable systems, and drive measurable firm growth.

Primary Objective: Own our firm's entire marketing function.

This is not a role for someone who simply manages projects or reports marketing metrics. We are looking for a leader who thinks like an owner, builds systems, solves problems, develops people, and drives measurable business growth. You will be responsible for our marketing strategy, budget, team, technology, analytics, and overall marketing performance. Success will be measured by results, continuous improvement, and your ability to build a marketing department that operates with minimal oversight.

Responsibilities


Develop and execute the firm's marketing strategy.
Own and manage the marketing budget.
Lead and develop the marketing team.
Manage outside vendors and agencies.
Oversee paid advertising, SEO, website strategy, social media, content, CRM, lead tracking, and marketing technology.
Ensure marketing efforts are measurable and continuously optimized.
Improve lead generation, conversion rates, and marketing ROI.
Build systems and processes that allow the department to operate efficiently with minimal oversight.


What We're Looking For


Ownership: You don't wait for direction.
You identify problems, develop solutions, make decisions, and take responsibility for results.
You think like an owner, not an employee.
Curiosity
One of the most important qualities we are looking for is curiosity.
We expect you to question data, investigate unexpected results, and understand why things happen.


For example, if reports show "Direct" becoming one of our largest lead sources, we don't want someone who simply reports the number.

We want someone who immediately starts asking questions.


Why is this happening?
Is our lead tracking working correctly?
Are UTMs missing?
Are our tracking numbers configured properly?
Is traffic bypassing attribution?
What information do we need to identify the root cause?
You don't need to know every answer immediately.
You do need to own finding the answer.
Builder and Leader
We are a growing business, not a large corporation.
We're looking for someone who can both lead and execute.
While your primary responsibility is building and leading the marketing department, you should be capable of stepping into any major marketing function when necessary.
If our marketing team disappeared tomorrow, you should be able to keep marketing moving while rebuilding the department.


We expect you to build a strong team, not become dependent on one.

Leadership: You will inherit an existing marketing team.

We expect you to evaluate the team, establish clear expectations, improve performance, redefine responsibilities when appropriate, and make hiring recommendations based on what's best for the business.

Preferred Experience


4 years experience leading marketing for a small or rapidly growing business.
3 years of previous experience working with AI search engine optimization (AEO)
Strong understanding of marketing analytics and ROI.
Experience managing budgets.
Experience leading people, agencies, and vendors.
Demonstrated success growing a business through marketing.
Comfortable making decisions with limited direction.
This includes understanding and being able to execute or oversee:
Paid advertising
SEO
Website management
Analytics and reporting
Lead attribution
CRM systems
Email marketing
Social media
Content strategy
Conversion optimization


Success in This Role: Within your first year, you should:


Build and execute a clear marketing strategy.
Improve lead attribution and reporting accuracy.
Increase marketing ROI.
Build a high-performing marketing team.
Create systems that reduce the owner's day-to-day involvement in marketing.


Our Philosophy


We don't hire people to complete tasks.
We hire people to own outcomes.
The right person notices problems before we do, investigates them without being asked, and brings thoughtful recommendations backed by data.


Deal Breaker

If you need someone to identify every problem, explain every issue, decide what should happen next, assign your work, and follow up to ensure it's completed, this role is not the right fit.

We're looking for someone who thinks independently, exercises sound judgment, takes ownership, and builds a marketing department that consistently delivers results with minimal oversight.

title: TikTok Shop Lead
skills: Q1 2026: $1,137,782 GMV · 13,728 orders · $83.32 AOV · 12.3% net margin · $140K net profit.
Blended GMV Max ROI: 6.16× against a blended break-even of 4.08× · CVR improved 1.12% → 2.30%.
Bamboo 4pc + 6pc = 76.8% of GMV · LIVE = 1.3% of GMV against a 10–20% category benchmark.
6,087 affiliates, 141 producing sales — a 2.3% activation rate · ~50 new affiliates/week.
GMV, contribution margin, net margin, blended and product-level break-even ROAS, AOV, refund rate. You set the targets and you defend the misses.
Monthly and quarterly forecasts with stated confidence levels and kill criteria — the format we already use, which you would inherit and improve.
Discount and promotion strategy. Seller discount currently runs 23.4% of GMV; whether that is right is one of the first questions you would answer.
Roughly $46K–$70K a month in GMV Max spend. Budget allocation, campaign structure, scaling and kill decisions.
Every campaign judged against contribution margin, not platform ROAS. We currently run several campaigns below blended break-even; finding and killing those is week-one work.
Creative fatigue management. Blended ad ROI has moved 6.4× → 5.6× → 4.3× across recent months and the diagnosis is not yet settled.
Strategy and targets for a 6,000+ affiliate program with a 2.3% activation rate. A Creator & Affiliate Manager executes; you own the economics, the commission architecture and the targets.
Closing the affiliate velocity gap — 50 a week against Bedsure's 187 and Shilucheng's 229. This is the metric we believe is the primary competitive moat in this category.
Sample program economics. We spent $71,600 on samples in Q1 and 31.5% of it is unattributed.
LIVE strategy from a near-standing start. It is 1.3% of our GMV against a 10–20% category benchmark, and it is the largest untapped channel we have.
Catalogue and bundle strategy. We are the only Tier-1 bedding shop on TikTok without bundles.
Content velocity targets and brief quality. Our own data shows content volume drives GMV at a two-to-four week lag, and a March content drop cost an estimated $30–50K.
Build AI into research, analysis, forecasting, creator discovery, brief generation and QA — and make the existing agent better by feeding back where it lacks context.
Treat AI output as a draft until the arithmetic, the source and the execution risk have been checked. We will test this directly and we will ask you to do it in front of us.
Humans keep control of pricing, money movement, creator contracts, compliance claims and anything customer-facing.
A weekly commercial view to the CEO: performance, risk, the decision you need, the next move.
Price parity and launch coordination with Amazon and DTC. TikTok cannot structurally undercut Amazon MAP.
Inventory coordination. Bamboo 4pc and 6pc have zero stockout tolerance — they are 77% of revenue.
Verified seller-side ownership of one named US TikTok Shop at $5M or more in trailing-twelve-month GMV, during a period when you personally held decision authority.
An agency portfolio total, or GMV summed across multiple client shops.
Total company revenue where TikTok Shop was one part.
A shop you advised, audited or supported without decision authority.

description:
About the job

ABOUT US

Ecotero LLC operates five private-label brands across roughly 20 active products, led by DECOLURE in premium bedding and home textiles. Amazon is the mature channel at $18M+ annually. TikTok Shop is the fastest-growing one and the one with the most headroom. DTC on Shopify is early.

We are a 27-person distributed team. What is genuinely unusual here is the analytical infrastructure: TikTok Order, Analytics and GMV Max APIs on a daily ETL into PostgreSQL, SKU-level COGS across 703 SKUs, FastMoss competitor tracking, and an AI operations agent that produces the quarterly performance analysis, competitor intelligence, creative briefs and P&L modelling. You would inherit a working analytics function on day one.




Where we actually are — the numbers you would inherit:

Q1 2026: $1,137,782 GMV · 13,728 orders · $83.32 AOV · 12.3% net margin · $140K net profit.
Blended GMV Max ROI: 6.16× against a blended break-even of 4.08× · CVR improved 1.12% → 2.30%.
Bamboo 4pc + 6pc = 76.8% of GMV · LIVE = 1.3% of GMV against a 10–20% category benchmark.
6,087 affiliates, 141 producing sales — a 2.3% activation rate · ~50 new affiliates/week.

We are telling you this before you apply rather than after you join. If the numbers look like a problem you want, the rest of this post is the job.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

The channel P&L

GMV, contribution margin, net margin, blended and product-level break-even ROAS, AOV, refund rate. You set the targets and you defend the misses.
Monthly and quarterly forecasts with stated confidence levels and kill criteria — the format we already use, which you would inherit and improve.
Discount and promotion strategy. Seller discount currently runs 23.4% of GMV; whether that is right is one of the first questions you would answer.




Paid growth — GMV Max

Roughly $46K–$70K a month in GMV Max spend. Budget allocation, campaign structure, scaling and kill decisions.
Every campaign judged against contribution margin, not platform ROAS. We currently run several campaigns below blended break-even; finding and killing those is week-one work.
Creative fatigue management. Blended ad ROI has moved 6.4× → 5.6× → 4.3× across recent months and the diagnosis is not yet settled.




GMV Max & Paid Advertising

Strategy and targets for a 6,000+ affiliate program with a 2.3% activation rate. A Creator & Affiliate Manager executes; you own the economics, the commission architecture and the targets.
Closing the affiliate velocity gap — 50 a week against Bedsure's 187 and Shilucheng's 229. This is the metric we believe is the primary competitive moat in this category.
Sample program economics. We spent $71,600 on samples in Q1 and 31.5% of it is unattributed.




LIVE, merchandising and content

LIVE strategy from a near-standing start. It is 1.3% of our GMV against a 10–20% category benchmark, and it is the largest untapped channel we have.
Catalogue and bundle strategy. We are the only Tier-1 bedding shop on TikTok without bundles.
Content velocity targets and brief quality. Our own data shows content volume drives GMV at a two-to-four week lag, and a March content drop cost an estimated $30–50K.




The AI operating model

Build AI into research, analysis, forecasting, creator discovery, brief generation and QA — and make the existing agent better by feeding back where it lacks context.
Treat AI output as a draft until the arithmetic, the source and the execution risk have been checked. We will test this directly and we will ask you to do it in front of us.
Humans keep control of pricing, money movement, creator contracts, compliance claims and anything customer-facing.




Cross-channel and executive

A weekly commercial view to the CEO: performance, risk, the decision you need, the next move.
Price parity and launch coordination with Amazon and DTC. TikTok cannot structurally undercut Amazon MAP.
Inventory coordination. Bamboo 4pc and 6pc have zero stockout tolerance — they are 77% of revenue.




REQUIRED EVIDENCE

The hard gate

Verified seller-side ownership of one named US TikTok Shop at $5M or more in trailing-twelve-month GMV, during a period when you personally held decision authority.




What does not count:

An agency portfolio total, or GMV summed across multiple client shops.
Total company revenue where TikTok Shop was one part.
A shop you advised, audited or supported without decision authority.
Non-US TikTok Shop scale on its own. Philippines, UK and SEA TikTok Shop operations are real expertise, but US creator culture, commission norms and LIVE behaviour are different enough that they do not substitute.




Also required

Direct GMV Max ownership at $30,000+ per month with authority over scaling and kill decisions.
Financial literacy that survives a live test. You should be able to derive break-even ROAS from a full cost stack — platform fee, commission, fulfilment, COGS, refunds — without notes. We will ask you to.

People leadership. You will direct a Creator & Affiliate Manager and coordinate contributors across functions.




Preferred

LIVE selling experience with real revenue behind it.
Multi-brand TikTok Shop operations.
Kalodata, FastMoss or equivalent competitive tooling.
Experience running TikTok Shop alongside a large Amazon business.

WHAT YOU'LL GET

Objetivo del puesto:

Conceptualizar y desarrollar estrategias de contenido multicanal orientadas tanto al posicionamiento orgánico como al performance (desde una perspectiva creativa y de mensajes). 

Este rol combina la agilidad narrativa para capitalizar tendencias en formatos de video corto (TikTok, Reels) con una sólida visión para plataformas tradicionales (META). 

Además, desempeña un papel clave en el contacto directo con los clientes para presentar, argumentar y vender de manera efectiva las propuestas creativas, respaldando siempre las ideas con datos y análisis de rendimiento orgánico.




Responsabilidades principales




Ideación y guionismo dinámico: Identificar tendencias en tiempo real y desarrollar guiones ágiles y creativos diseñados específicamente para TikTok, Reels y Shorts.
Estrategia multicanal (META): Diseñar y supervisar la parrilla de contenidos para Instagram y Facebook, manteniendo la coherencia visual y el tone of voice de cada marca.
Presentación a clientes: Liderar reuniones de pitch, propuestas creativas y entregas mensuales frente al cliente con narrativa clara y seguridad.
Análisis de performance y reportes: Monitorear el rendimiento del contenido orgánico, interpretar métricas clave (reach, engagement, retención de video) y elaborar reportes con aprendizajes accionables.
Gestión y organización de flujos de trabajo: Priorizar y coordinar un alto volumen de pendientes, entregables y solicitudes de forma autónoma y estructurada.




Perfil y requisitos




Experiencia: 3 a 5 años en roles de creación de contenido, social media strategy o creativos en agencias publicitarias o marcas.
Dominio de plataformas: Conocimiento profundo del lenguaje nativo de TikTok, algoritmos de META y herramientas de analítica orgánica (Meta Business Suite, TikTok Analytics).
Habilidades de comunicación: Excelente oratoria, capacidad de síntesis y desarrollo de presentaciones ejecutivas visualmente atractivas.
Competencias personales: Altamente organizado/a, capacidad para trabajar bajo presión, pensamiento analítico orientado a datos y sensibilidad por las tendencias pop/digitales.




Te ofrecemos




Formar parte de una compañía disruptiva, con nuevos dinamismos de trabajo y un ritmo retador.

Aquí podrás aprender en poco tiempo lo que te llevaría años en otro espacio, contando con un atractivo paquete de compensación y crecimiento profesional. 




Modelo full time, híbrido: vamos 2 veces por semana a nuestras oficinas ubicadas en San Miguel Chapultepec.

Desayuno los días de Oficina.

Vacaciones: 15 días.

Prestaciones de Ley

About the job

About RS Group

RS is a high-service global product and service solutions provider for industrial customers, enabling them to operate efficiently and sustainably.

We operate in 33 markets, stock over 875,000 industrial and specialist products and list an additional five million relevant for our industrial customers, sourced from over 2,500 suppliers. We enhance their experience through a tailored service model, leveraging our efficient physical, digital and process infrastructure sustainably. Our purpose, making amazing happen for a better world, reflects our focus on delivering results for people, planet and profit.

The core purpose of this role is to provide data and insight across the Global Shared Services functions, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Order Processing. title: Appointment Setter
description:
About the job

To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.




Job Title: Sales & Customer Success Representative




About the Company:

Our client is a real estate company operating in Canada.




Job Description:

This person will be responsible for handling inbound calls, following up with existing leads, qualifying prospects, and setting appointments for the company's field sales representatives. The ideal candidate is confident on the phone, has strong English communication skills, and is comfortable with consistent follow-up and handling rejection. The company already has a strong supply of leads, including names and phone numbers, so this role is primarily focused on calling, following up, qualifying, and moving prospects toward an appointment or sale. The role requires someone who can spend a significant portion of the day on the phone and consistently follow up with prospects.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Answer inbound calls and speak with prospective customers.

• Follow up consistently with existing leads via phone.

• Re-engage customers who have not yet moved forward.

• Qualify prospects and determine their level of interest.

• Set appointments for field sales representatives to visit customers at their homes.

• Maintain consistent communication with prospects throughout the sales process.

• Handle objections and rejection professionally.

• Look for opportunities to move qualified prospects toward a sale.

• Potentially assist with closing deals when appropriate.

• Keep accurate records of calls, follow-ups, and customer interactions.

• Work closely with the sales team to ensure leads are properly handed off.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Previous sales, telemarketing, customer service, or call-center experience preferred.

• Excellent spoken English and clear communication skills.

• Strong phone presence and professional communication style.

• Comfortable making a high volume of calls.

• Persistent and resilient when dealing with rejection.

• Able to stay motivated after hearing "no" repeatedly.

• Strong follow-up skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Comfortable working an evening-oriented schedule.

• Real estate experience is a plus but not explicitly required.




Preferred Skills:

• Real estate experience.




Personality:

• Naturally comfortable talking to people.

• Not afraid to pick up the phone.

• Persistent even when prospects say no.

• Enjoys the challenge of turning leads into appointments and opportunities.




Software & Tools:

• CRM or similar tools for record keeping.




Schedule:

Full-time, approximately 8 hours per day.

Proposed schedule of around 11:00 AM–7:00 PM Mountain Time.




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

• Base hourly rate.

• Possibility of commission or additional compensation for candidates who are able to close deals.

description:
About the job

Job Title: Creator & Affiliate Partnerships Manager (TikTok & Discord)

Location: Remote (LATAM or CEE preferred)

Compensation: USD $2,000–2,500/month

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST or PST

Type: Independent Contractor




About the Role

We're hiring a Creator & Affiliate Partnerships Manager to build, scale, and manage the creator and affiliate ecosystem across multiple ecommerce brands. This is a partnerships and community role first — you'll recruit and activate creators, grow affiliate programs, and lead community engagement (primarily on Discord) that drives brand awareness and revenue.

You'll work inside a growing ecommerce accelerator scaling direct-to-consumer brands across Amazon, Shopify, and Walmart. To be clear: content posting and day-to-day social media are secondary here — success is measured by creator recruitment, affiliate activation, community growth, and relationship quality.




What You'll Do

Recruit, onboard, and activate creators, affiliates, and brand ambassadors at scale.
Run high-volume outreach across TikTok, Instagram, Discord, and email, and maintain a healthy partner pipeline.
Expand and optimize affiliate programs across multiple ecommerce brands, including incentive and retention initiatives.
Manage and grow creator and affiliate communities, primarily on Discord — driving engagement, challenges, and campaigns.
Serve as the primary point of contact for creators and affiliates, resolving issues and ensuring a great experience.
Identify top performers and build retention strategies that keep them active.
Coordinate creator campaigns and affiliate initiatives across brands with marketing and ecommerce teams.
Track recruitment, activation, engagement, and retention metrics, and deliver weekly performance reports.




What We're Looking For

3+ years in affiliate marketing, influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or community management.
Proven experience recruiting and onboarding creators, affiliates, influencers, or ambassadors.
Experience running high-volume outreach and relationship-building campaigns.
Experience managing online communities, preferably Discord-based.
Strong understanding of TikTok creator ecosystems and affiliate programs.
Excellent communication and relationship-management skills.
Highly organized with strong project-management abilities.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.
Professional English communication skills.




Nice to Have

Experience with TikTok Shop or affiliate-driven ecommerce brands.
Experience scaling creator or ambassador programs.
Familiarity with Shopify, Amazon, or Walmart ecommerce ecosystems.
Experience managing teams, community moderators, or creator coordinators.
Knowledge of creator performance tracking and affiliate analytics.
Video editing or creative direction for short-form content.
